Under Dharti Aaba Janjatiya Gram Utkarsh Abhiyan (DA JGUA), during the current financial year, Ministry has also approved projects amounting to Rs.12574.70 lakhs

in State of West Bengal for MoTA components under the abhiyan. In respect of Purulia district. approvals have been accorded for:

Construction of 204 Additional Classrooms amounting to Rs 2,417.3 lakh;

1 Hostel Repair/Renovation work amounting to Rs 39.99 lakh; and

1 Tribal Multi-Purpose Marketing Centre (TMMC) amounting to Rs 100 lakh.

State Government had undertaken habitation level data collection exercise through PM Gati Shakti mobile application to estimate PVTG population figures and infrastructure gaps in order to cover PVTG population residing in villages & habitations under PM JANMAN. The details of number of PVTG habitations identified (tentative) and PVTG population in the State of West Bengal is tabulated below:

Ministry has been regularly taking up the issue of implementation of activities under PM JANMAN with State Government of West Bengal.

Besides, PVTG household survey is also ongoing in State of West Bengal and State Government has surveyed 18173 PVTG households. The State Government is required to examine the data captured and take appropriate action in consultation with line Departments to address the gaps identified in terms of schemes norms and eligibility criteria.

The responsibility of allocation and release of funds to districts is the responsibility of State Government. Hence, the records of funds allocated, released and utilized, district-wise, is maintained by the State Government.

The formulation and submission of proposals is the responsibility of State Government and District Administration. State Government had not submitted any proposals for MPCs including in Purulia District to Ministry of Tribal Affairs. However, Ministry of Tribal Affairs has carried out an orientation programme on schemes of MoTA including PM JANMAN and DA JGUA for Officers of State Governments to facilitate formulation of proposals and progress thereon.
